title: 第 706章 提升焚天裂空爪的威能第 705章 引起两族对峙
slug: 残鼎复元陆家修仙崛起路
content_zh:
第706章提升焚天裂空爪的威能
陆行舟躲在海底，察觉到妖兽禽离去，并未着急动身，等待了半日时间，确定再无妖禽踪迹，这才一把抓住老者，冲破水面跃出。
他放出神识环顾四周，再三确认没有危险，这才与老者化作两道流光，朝着石城方向疾驰而去。
数天之后，二人终于返回到了石城外围。
陆行舟转头看向身侧的老者，缓缓开口：“小友，你独自回城即可，我另有要事，不过，猎杀离火鸠一事，我不希望城中有任何人议论。”
他虽然不相信这次妖禽暴乱与自己猎杀离火鸠有关，但小心无大错。
老者连忙躬身行礼，神色郑重：“前辈放心，晚辈绝不会向外吐露半分，您赐我婴灵水，护我周全，此等大恩，晚辈此生铭记。”
陆行舟摆了摆手，神色无波无澜：“不用如此，只是一场交易罢了，你我就此别过。”
说罢，他不再多言，身形一闪，化作一道虹光，调转方向，毅然朝着风暴海域疾驰而去。
风暴海域地处万妖海最深处，乃是妖族有名的绝境险地。
风暴海域位于万妖海深处，陆行舟一路绕行，避开那些高阶妖兽的地盘，花了近两个月时间才赶到外围。
远方整片天际都被无尽狂暴狂风笼罩，罡风呼啸纵横，撕裂云层、搅动沧海，声势骇人至极。
他驻足海面，看着远方，心中暗自道：这就是风暴海域吗？也不清楚是怎么形成的，为何古妖秘境会出现在这。
他听闻风暴中心区域，狂暴的罡风能撕裂万物，即便元婴修士闯入，不到几个呼吸便会被绞碎，连神魂都无法逃脱。
陆行舟收敛心神，在外围寻了一处数丈大小的荒芜礁岛，开辟出一间简陋洞府，布下隐匿阵法，这才回到洞府盘膝而坐。
他摸出几瓶离火鸠的精血放在身旁，抬手打开一瓶，将精血牵引出来，用灵力包裹。
随即，他掐动法诀，一团灵火飞出，缓慢淬炼精血、剔除杂质。
经过十余天的提纯，所有精血最终化作四滴色泽金红、隐隐流转着朱雀虚影的精血。
陆行舟将这几滴精血逐一融入体内，同时运转焚天裂空爪功法，让朱雀精血与自身气血彻底融合。
两个月后，他冲出洞府，悬浮海面，右手五指骤然成爪，指尖亮起细碎璀璨星光，同时萦绕着三色火焰。

他全力调动体内气血与灵力，手臂猛地向前一挥。
虚空中一道清脆的鸣啼声响起，一只数十丈大小的金色巨爪凭空凝聚，爪纹清晰如真，巨爪裹挟滔天威压拍向海面。
“轰！”
海水被硬生生拍开，数十丈高的巨浪朝两侧翻涌而起，海面中央被撕裂出一道深不见底的沟壑，水汽被火焰瞬间蒸发成茫茫白雾，弥漫整片海域。
巨浪退去后，海面久久无法合拢，仍在剧烈翻涌。
“不错，又多一道顶尖底牌。”陆行舟眼中闪过一丝满意之色。
他看着海面，暗自思忖，如今焚天裂空爪以星辰之力与三色火焰辅助，加上爪影本身的撕裂之力，足以轻松破开寻常元婴中期修士的防御。
只是不知这套功法修炼至圆满境界，是否真能如纸张上记载，拥有徒手撕裂虚空的能力。
他收敛气息，重新落回礁岛，打坐调息，等待风暴海域的虚弱期到来。
content_en:
Chapter 706: Improving the Power of Burning Sky Splitting Claw
Lu Xingzhou hid at the bottom of the sea and noticed that the monster beasts and birds were leaving. He did not leave in a hurry. He waited for half a day and was sure that there was no trace of the monster birds anymore. Then he grabbed the old man and jumped out of the water.
He released his consciousness and looked around, confirming again and again that there was no danger, and then he and the old man turned into two streams of light and sped towards Shicheng.
A few days later, the two finally returned to the outskirts of Stone City.
Lu Xingzhou turned to look at the old man beside him and said slowly: "My friend, you can go back to the city alone. I have other important matters. However, I don't want anyone in the city to talk about the hunting of Li Huojiu."
Although he did not believe that the demon bird riot was related to his hunting of Li Huojiu, he was careful and there was no big mistake.
The old man quickly bowed and saluted with a solemn expression: "Senior, don't worry, I will never reveal anything to anyone. You gave me baby spirit water and protected me. This great kindness will be remembered by this junior in my life."
Lu Xingzhou waved his hand with a calm expression: "That's not necessary. It's just a transaction. You and I will say goodbye."
After that, he said no more, his body flashed, turned into a rainbow light, turned around, and galloped resolutely towards the stormy sea.
The Storm Sea is located in the deepest part of the Sea of ​​Ten Thousand Demons, and is a famous dangerous place for the demon clan.
The Storm Sea is located deep in the Sea of ​​Ten Thousand Monsters. Lu Xingzhou circled all the way to avoid the territory of high-level monsters, and it took him nearly two months to reach the outskirts.
The entire sky in the distance was shrouded in endless violent winds. The wind roared in all directions, tearing the clouds apart and stirring the sea, and the sound was extremely terrifying.
He stopped on the sea, looked into the distance, and thought to himself: Is this the stormy sea area? I don’t know how it was formed or why the ancient demon secret realm appeared here.
He heard that in the center of the storm, the violent wind could tear apart everything. Even if the Nascent Soul cultivator broke in, he would be crushed in less than a few breaths, and even the soul could not escape.
Lu Xingzhou gathered his thoughts, found a deserted island several feet in size on the periphery, opened up a simple cave, set up a concealment formation, and then returned to the cave to sit cross-legged.
He took out several bottles of Li Huojiu's blood essence and placed them beside him. He raised his hand to open one bottle, pulled out the blood essence, and wrapped it with spiritual power.
Immediately, he pressed the magic formula, and a ball of spiritual fire flew out, slowly refining the blood essence and removing impurities.
After more than ten days of purification, all the blood essence was finally transformed into four drops of golden-red blood with faint shadows of the Suzaku.
Lu Xingzhou integrated these drops of essence and blood into his body one by one, and at the same time used the Burning Sky Splitting Claw technique to completely integrate the Suzaku essence and blood with his own qi and blood.
Two months later, he rushed out of the cave and floated on the sea. The five fingers of his right hand suddenly turned into claws, and the fingertips lit up with tiny bright stars, while three-color flames lingered.
He mobilized all his energy, blood and spiritual power, and swung his arms forward.
A clear cry sounded in the void, and a golden giant claw tens of feet in size condensed out of thin air. The claw marks were clear and real. The giant claw slapped towards the sea with overwhelming pressure.
"Boom!"
The sea water was forcefully pushed away, and huge waves tens of feet high surged towards both sides. A bottomless ravine was torn out in the center of the sea surface. The water vapor was instantly evaporated by the flames into a vast white mist, which filled the entire sea area.
After the huge waves receded, the sea surface could not close for a long time and was still surging violently.
"That's right, another top trump card." A trace of satisfaction flashed in Lu Xingzhou's eyes.
He looked at the sea and thought to himself, now the Burning Sky Splitting Claw is assisted by the power of stars and three-color flames, coupled with the tearing power of the claw shadow itself, it is enough to easily break through the defense of ordinary mid-stage Nascent Soul monks.
I just don’t know if after practicing this set of exercises to a perfect state, I can really have the ability to tear the void with my bare hands, as recorded on the paper.
He gathered his breath, returned to the island, meditated and adjusted his breath, waiting for the period of weakness in the stormy sea to arrive.
